author: Megaprojects
description:
Anduril's Dive-LD is a modular underwater drone built for long-duration missions at extreme depths. Three veterans of the submarine robotics industry designed it using 3D-printed panels and a free-flooded aluminium frame. The US Navy now operates the vehicle, though Iran's capture of one highlights the risks of autonomous undersea operations.
